definitions.explanation: Describes something exceptionally large in size, used for products, portions, and items that exceed the standard large size.

examples.japanese: {特大|とくだい}サイズをください。
examples.english: I'd like the extra-large size, please.

examples.japanese: {特大|とくだい}のホームランがスタンドに{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: A towering home run flew into the stands.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}の{特大|とくだい}パフェは{一人|ひとり}では{食|た}べきれないほど{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: This shop's jumbo parfait is so big that one person can't finish it.

notes: Functions as a pre-noun modifier: {特大|とくだい}サイズ (extra-large size), {特大|とくだい}ニュース (big news), {特大|とくだい}ホームラン (towering home run). Often used in product descriptions and restaurant menus. The prefix {特|とく}～ means "special" and appears in many compounds: {特急|とっきゅう} (express train), {特売|とくばい} (special sale). Related: {大型|おおがた} (large-sized — a standard descriptor), {超大型|ちょうおおがた} (super-large).
